title: Which version of The New World (2005) should I watch?

commenti.body: The 172-minute is Malick's intended way to watch it. It's the way I first watched, and the way I still prefer. It's the lead release in the criterion version for that reason. It's a little slower, but there are some key scenes I really miss from the theatrical cut.
Personally, I’ve only seen the 172 minute cut and think it’s an absolute masterpiece. I couldn’t imagine myself enjoying the shorter cut more so I’ve never even considered watching it.
Correct, because each one since has been perfect
